summary: Expand Energy Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing an underwriting agreement dated September 15, 2026, with Citigroup and J.P. Morgan as representatives for an underwritten public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.650% senior notes due 2031. The offering was priced on September 15, 2026, registered under an existing Form S-3 shelf, with closing subject to customary conditions expected September 17, 2026. The filing also furnished a press release under Regulation FD. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity terms, premium, or deal structure are implicated.
